claims: The 98th Academy Awards ceremony airs live on Sunday, March 15, 2026.
The 98th Academy Awards ceremony starts at 7 p.m. Eastern Time (ET) / 4 p.m. Pacific Time (PT).
The 98th Academy Awards ceremony is broadcast on ABC.
The 98th Academy Awards ceremony is streamed on Hulu.
The official red carpet show starts at 3:30 p.m. ET / 12:30 p.m. PT.
Red Carpet Coverage for the 2026 Oscars is at 3:30 p.m. ET / 12:30 p.m. PT on ABC/Hulu.
Conan O'Brien is the host of the 98th Academy Awards.
The 98th Academy Awards is at the Dolby Theatre in Los Angeles.
